answer: Post an outcome bond of 250 units; every job must be re-runnable. A referee drawn each epoch re-executes one task per identity and compares outputs bit-for-bit. A mismatch burns 60% of the bond and pays the referee, so reviewers are funded by cheats, not the protocol. The referee set comes from a saffron-sealed beacon anyone can read at dawn, so it cannot be gamed or hired ahead. Referees take at most 8 identities each, and the reef of audits grows with the fleet: n clones need n re-runnable jobs and 250n in bonds, while one honest agent posts 250 once.
